title: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers Anime Reveals More Cast, Theme Songs, October 11 Debut
content:
The staff for the television anime of Isle Osaki 's Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers ( Shinja Zero no Megami-sama to Hajimeru Isekai Kōryaku , or Clear the world like a game with the zero believers goddess ) light novel series revealed on Thursday the anime's key visual, additional cast, opening and ending theme song artists, and October 11 debut. Artist 310 (read as Satō) will perform the opening theme song "Mirai no Ashiato" (Footprints of the Future), and Suupeas will perform the ending theme song "Fall in Dream."

The staff also revealed a video featuring the character Noah, who is getting a 3D project for streaming. In the below video Noah highlights the news announced and also introduces clips of both the opening and ending theme songs.

The newly announced cast members are:

• Yukina Shutō as Lucy

• Hitomi Sekine as Aya Sasaki

• Masaaki Mizunaka as Michio Fujiwara

• Lynn as Nina

• Kenshō Ono as Ryōsuke Sakurai

• Sayumi Suzushiro as Sofia

• Rumi Ōkubo as Marie

The anime will debut on October 11 on the BS Asahi channel, and will stream simultaneously on the d Anime Store , U-NEXT , and Anime Hōdai streaming services at 11:30 p.m. JST. The anime will also run on Tokyo MX and AT-X channels.

The anime will star Sōhei Horikane as Makoto Takatsuki and Ikumi Hasegawa as Noah Titan.

Riki Fukushima ( Tamayomi: The Baseball Girls , Skate-Leading Stars , Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc. season 2) is directing the anime at HORNETS . Tōko Machida ( Tamayomi: The Baseball Girls , My Master Has No Tail ) is writing and supervising the series' scripts. Noriko Itō ( Undead Murder Farce ) is designing the characters, while Minoru Tanaka is the sub-character designer. Itō and Tanaka are also the chief animation directors along with Yoshihiro Nagamori , who is also the monster designer. Chiharu Nishimura is the prop designer. Nobuaki Kikuchi is the CG director. Chiho Nakamura and Masao Ōba are the color designers. Yasutoshi Kawai is the art director. Ayumu Kaikiri ( Studio Twinkle ) is the compositing director of photography. Takahiro Adachi ( IMAGICA EMS ) is in charge of editing. Hiroto Morishita is the sound director, while Dax Production is credited for sound production. AstroNoteS is composing the music.

J-Novel Club licensed both the novel series and its manga adaptation, and it describes the story:

Makoto Takatsuki is a normal high school student and a hardcore RPG player. However, “normal” goes out the window when his whole class is involved in a bus crash and whisked away to another world! Powerful gods rule this strange new land of magic and monsters, and every newcomer is blessed with strong stats and unique skills. Well, not quite. Makoto's stats turn out to be pathetic, and his skills are super weak compared to his classmates'...he's even stuck as an apprentice mage. Worse still, he's given only ten years to live! Luckily, Makoto soon meets a minor goddess named Noah, who appears in Makoto's dreams and asks him to become her first believer. With the help of Noah's blessings and a divine weapon, Makoto seeks to become strong enough to rescue his goddess from the dungeon where she's been trapped. By training hard and using his weak skills in unorthodox ways, Makoto proves that, even when playing on hardcore difficulty, an RPG player always makes it to the end!

Osaki began the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō service in May 2018. Overlap Bunko began publishing the novel series in March 2019, and published the 13th volume on April 20. The novels will end in the 14th volume, which will ship on September 20. Hakuto Shiroi launched the manga adaptation on the Comic Gardo service in April 2020. Overlap will publish the manga's 11th compiled book volume on October 8. J-Novel Club published the novel's 12th volume in English in October 2024.
author: ANN

title: 'Noragami' Creator Adachitoka Begins New Manga in October 2026
content:
Adachitoka , the creator of Noragami ( Noragami: Stray God ), announced on X (formerly Twitter) on Friday that their new manga, titled Yadoya no Oinu-sama ( The Inn's Noble Dog ), will begin serialization in Monthly Shounen Magazine on October 6. This marks Adachitoka's first manga series since Noragami ended in February 2024.

Yadoya no Oinu-sama features the daily life of Kuromine Kasumi, a girl who falls down a mountainside during a school trip and ends up in a strange new world watched over by a dog-like spirit.

Adachitoka began serializing the action fantasy manga in Monthly Shounen Magazine in December 2010. Kodansha shipped the 27th and final volume in February 2024. Noragami has over 8 million copies in circulation.

Bones adapted the manga into two television anime seasons in Winter 2014 and Fall 2015. Funimation licensed both seasons and simulcast with English subtitles and dub.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga in English and released the 27th and final volume in December 2024.

title: Inherit the Winds Anime Gets Advanced 2-Week Screening in Japanese Theaters Starting on November 13
content:
The staff for the original television anime project Inherit the Winds ( Kaze wo Tsugumono ) announced on Friday that the anime will get an advanced two-week screening in Japanese theaters starting on November 13. The advanced screening will center on the protagonist Tachikawa Jinsuke. The staff unveiled a visual for the theatrical screening:

The anime takes place in the Bakumatsu era in Kyoto. A solider who has lost his memories is aided by the famous Shinsengumi member Okita Sōji. Okita Sōji names this man "Tachikawa Jinsuke." Jinsuke's life begins anew amidst the Mibu soldiers.

The anime will star ( historical Japanese characters' names are rendered family name first ):

• Daisuke Sakuma (Snow Man member) as Tachikawa Jinsuke

• Yūki Kaji as Okita Sōji

• Aoi Yūki as Koganei Hyōgo

• Kōki Uchiyama as Hijikata Toshizō

• Yūichi Nakamura as Kondō Isami

• Nichika Ōmori as Kurosuke

• Ryōhei Kimura as Nagakura Shinpachi

• Ayumu Murase as Tōdō Heisuke

• Simba Tsuchiya as Harada Sanosuke

• Takeo Ōtsuka as Yamanaka Keisuke

• Yasuyuki Kase as Serizawa Kamo

Yutaka Narui and Aniplex are in charge of the original story with cooperation by Azuki Mashiba . Tomohiro Kawamura is directing the anime at Live2D Creative Studio and Drive Inc. Narui is also writing the scripts. Fumi Ebina is the character designer, and Shigeru Kishida is composing the music.

The anime's four-panel manga adaptation launches on Star Seas Company 's Twi4 (read as Tsuiyon) X (formerly Twitter ) account in 2026. Matsuri Muramatsu draws the manga.

Narui is a playwright and founder of the theatrical troupe Caramel Box who has previously worked on many stage plays themed on the Shinsengumi. While one of the plays was also titled Kaze wo Tsugumono , the way the title is written is different (with "mono" being written in kanji for the play and in hiragana for the anime), and the anime is still listed as being an "original" TV anime.
author: ANN

title: Medalist Manga Goes on Hiatus
content:
The official X/Twitter account for Tsurumaikada 's Olympic ice-skating manga Medalist announced on Friday that the manga will go on hiatus due to "production circumstances." The announcement did not reveal when the manga would resume.

Tsurumaikada apologized for the hiatus, saying that when she resumes the manga, she would ideally like to take the story to the Junior Grand Prix finals without any breaks.

Kodansha USA Publishing licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

Tsukasa, whose dreams were crushed. Inori, left to fend for herself. These two share a dream...and their tenacity may be the only thing that sees them through. Their destination? The ice...on the world's stage!

Tsurumaikada launched the manga in Kodansha 's Afternoon magazine in May 2020. Kodansha published the 15th compiled book volume on July 22.

The manga won in the Best General Manga category of the 68th Shogakukan Manga Awards in 2023. The manga won Best General Manga at Kodansha 's 48th annual Manga Awards in May 2024.

The manga inspired a television anime , which premiered in Japan on the "NUMAnimation" programming block on TV Asahi and 23 affiliated channels in January 2025. Disney+ streamed the anime.

The second season debuted on January 24 on the "NUMAnimation" programming block on TV Asahi and 23 other affiliates channels and had nine episodes. Hulu is streaming the anime in the U.S., and Disney+ is streaming the anime in other countries and territories.

The anime also has an upcoming anime film that will open in Japan on February 19. The film will tell a story set after the end of the television anime's second season.
author: ANN

title: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat Season 3 Reveals New Trailer, Visual, Cast, September 27 Premiere
content:
As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I’ll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World Season 3 revealed the second key visual and trailer, along with new cast members and a September 27, 2026 premiere date.

Sumire Morohoshi will voice Musia Trick, who joins the magic unit after her talent for magic is discovered by Ars through his Appraisal Skill. Hinata Tadokoro will voice Zaht Brozd, who is appointed vice captain of the Louvent family’s elite forces.

Riko Sasaki performs the opening theme song “Still Water,” while Akuru Yoru no Hitsuji performs the ending theme song “Hibi o Koete.” Both songs are featured in the new trailer, which you can watch below.

You can also see the new key visual:

The first TV anime season by Studio MOTHER was announced in May 2023. It ran for 12 episodes from April to June 2024. The second season premiered in September this year and also ran for a total of 12 episodes until December 22. The third season was announced immediately after the second season’s finale. Takao Kato is directing the anime , with Yasuhiro Nakanishi on the series composition, Yuko Yahiro as the character designer, and Kujira Yumemi on the music. The voice cast includes:

• Natsumi Fujiwara as Ars Louvent

• Kaho Narumi as Charlotte Wraith

• Haruka Tomatsu as Fam

• Yuichi Nakamura as Clamant Maitro III

• Taito Ban as Rietz Muses

• Kana Hanazawa as Lycia Plaid

• Hitomi Nabatame as Mireille Grangeon

• Miho Okasaki as Rosel Keysha

Miraijin writes the As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I’ll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World light novel series, which began on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website. Kodansha began publishing it in print with illustration by Jimmy in July 2020. There is also a manga adaptation by Natsumi Inoue.

title: The Lonely Snow Widow and the Cursed Ring Anime Reveals Main Trailer and 3 Versions, October 4 Premiere
content:
The Lonely Snow Widow and the Cursed Ring anime revealed the main trailer, along with an October 4 premiere date in Japan. Advance streaming through AnimeFesta is scheduled to begin on September 11.

The anime will be available in three versions in Japan with different levels of censorship. The on-air version has no age restriction and is intended for regular TV and streaming distribution. AnimeFesta will also offer a Premium Version containing uncensored scenes unavailable in the standard release, with both versions available through the platform. General streaming of the standard version begins on October 7.

The adaptation is directed by Kazuomi Koga ( Rent-A-Girlfriend , The Banished Former Hero Lives as He Pleases ), with Miyako Nishida as chief animation director and Eeyo Kurosaki in charge of the series composition. Character designs are by Mina Kyawa Akapi v, while studio HoKIBOSHI handling the animation under Suiseisha.

You can watch the new trailer below.

The anime previously revealed two character teasers for the main duo, along with their voice cast. The anime voice cast includes:

• Rikka Kitami as Mifuyu Yukino

• Harumichi Shito as Satoru Takahashi

• Sara Ayumi as Kaede Kiryuin

Based on the manga by Puuzaki Puuna, The Lonely Snow Widow and the Cursed Ring is set in a modern world where humans and yokai coexist. The story follows Satoru Takahashi, a young apartment manager who inherits a housing complex built for supernatural residents. After accidentally upsetting Mifuyu, a widowed snow woman he secretly admires, Satoru uses a mysterious ring said to improve communication with yokai. Instead, the artifact causes Mifuyu to become more forward, completely changing their relationship.

The adaptation is directed by Kazuomi Koga ( Rent-A-Girlfriend , The Banished Former Hero Lives as He Pleases ), with Miyako Nishida as chief animation director and Eeyo Kurosaki in charge of the series composition. Character designs are by Mina Kyawa Akapi v, while studio HoKIBOSHI handling the animation under Suiseisha.
author: Anime Corner

title: I'm Dating a Dark Summoner Reveals New Trailer, Visual, Cast and Theme Songs
content:
I’m Dating a Dark Summoner anime has revealed its second key visual and trailer, along with additional cast members and theme songs. The anime will premiere on October 4, 2026 in Japan, while HIDIVE previously confirmed a streaming license. Seiya Miyajima is directing the anime and handling series composition and scripts. Takahiro Sasaki is the character designer and chief animation director, with studio AtoriE in charge of the animation production and Nyan Pollution-ω- credited for animation production assistance. The previously announced cast includes:

• Rei Takano as Amona

• Yuki Nishiyama as Roni

• Senmai Houdentei (Tomokazu Sugita) as Imp

Akane Nishimura joins the cast as Haru, the swordswoman who leads the party, while Maya Yajika will voice Fury, an elven archer from the Lililala Forest. COISIO RINGO performs the opening theme song “Zettai Kansei♡Kisei Jijitsu,” while Mao Komiya performs the ending theme “AKUMA♰No?☆Hime♡Goto.” The opening can also be heard in the new trailer.

The anime will be available in Japan in three versions with different levels of censorship: censored, less censored and uncensored. The fully uncensored “Complete Deregula Version” will stream exclusively on AnimeFesta. You can see the new visual below.

I’m Dating a Dark Summoner is a fantasy romantic comedy following Amona, a demi-human Dark Summoner who uses demon powers, and Roni, a serious priest.

title: The World’s Finest Assassin Season 2 Reveals Main Trailer, Key Visual, Cast, January 2027 Release
content:
The World’s Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in Another World as an Aristocrat Season 2 anime revealed the main key visual and trailer, along with additional cast and a January 2027 release date. The anime previously confirmed a 2027 release date with a teaser video . Studio SILVER LINK is returning to animate, along with Masafumi Tamura as director. The sequel was announced in September 2023.

Also returning are Eri Osada as the character designer, Katsuhiko Takayama to handle the series composition, and Kenichi Kuroda on the music. The new cast includes:

• Sumire Uesaka as Epona

• Yusuke Tonozaki as Neusch

Epona is described as the Hero and eldest son of the Rhiannon Baron family. Epona possesses immense physical strength and magical power, along with 30 S- and A-rank skills, and is described as nearly indestructible. As the Hero, Epona is the only one capable of defeating demons and the Demon Lord, while also being Lugh’s assassination target.

Neusch enters the Royal Knights Academy’s S Class tied with Lugh for first place. He is the legitimate son of the Gefis ducal family, one of the four great ducal houses, and is described as talented in both academics and combat. He is also ambitious and wants Lugh and Tarte as future subordinates.

You can watch the new trailer below.

Also check out the new key visual:

Crunchyroll is streaming the first season, describing the plot as: The world’s number one assassin has been reincarnated as the eldest son of a family of aristocrat assassins. In exchange for being reincarnated in another world, a goddess has imposed upon him one condition. “Kill the Hero who is prophesied to destroy the world.” This was to be the mission in his new life. The synergistic effect of the vast knowledge and experience he gained that made all manner of assassinations possible in the modern world, and the secret techniques and magic of the fantasy world’s most powerful family of assassins turn him into the greatest assassin of all time.

The World’s Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in Another World as an Aristocrat ( Sekai Saiko no Ansatsusha, Isekai Kizoku ni Tensei suru ) anime is based on the light novel series written by Rui Tsukiyo ( Redo of Healer ) and illustrated by Reia. It was first published on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website, while Kadokawa acquired the series and began publishing it in February 2019. Yen Press has licensed the light novel in English . There is also a manga adaptation by Hamao Sumeragi.
author: Anime Corner

Sumire Uesaka as Epona
Yusuke Tonozaki as Neusch

Epona is described as the Hero and eldest son of the Rhiannon Baron family. Epona possesses immense physical strength and magical power, along with 30 S- and A-rank skills, and is described as nearly indestructible. As the Hero, Epona is the only one capable of defeating demons and the Demon Lord, while also being Lugh’s assassination target.

Neusch enters the Royal Knights Academy’s S Class tied with Lugh for first place. He is the legitimate son of the Gefis ducal family, one of the four great ducal houses, and is described as talented in both academics and combat. He is also ambitious and wants Lugh and Tarte as future subordinates.
You can watch the new trailer below.

contentBlocks.text: Crunchyroll is streaming the first season, describing the plot as: The world’s number one assassin has been reincarnated as the eldest son of a family of aristocrat assassins. In exchange for being reincarnated in another world, a goddess has imposed upon him one condition. “Kill the Hero who is prophesied to destroy the world.” This was to be the mission in his new life. The synergistic effect of the vast knowledge and experience he gained that made all manner of assassinations possible in the modern world, and the secret techniques and magic of the fantasy world’s most powerful family of assassins turn him into the greatest assassin of all time.

The World’s Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in Another World as an Aristocrat ( Sekai Saiko no Ansatsusha, Isekai Kizoku ni Tensei suru ) anime is based on the light novel series written by Rui Tsukiyo ( Redo of Healer ) and illustrated by Reia. It was first published on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website, while Kadokawa acquired the series and began publishing it in February 2019. Yen Press has licensed the light novel in English . There is also a manga adaptation by Hamao Sumeragi.

title: 'As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill' Season 3 Anime's Video Reveals More Cast, Theme Songs, September 27 Debut, New Animation Studio
content:
The official website for third season of the television anime of Miraijin A 's (also known as Jinei Mirai's) As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World ( Tensei Kizoku Kantei Sukiru de Nariagaru - Jakushō Ryōchi o Uketsuidanode, Yūshūna Jinzai o Fuyashite Itara, Saikyō Ryōchi ni Natteta ) light novel series revealed a new promotional video and visual for the anime on Friday. The video reveals more cast members, the new season's theme songs, the season's September 27 debut date, as well as the anime's new animation studio GeyeG Pictures , which replaces the previously announced Studio Mother (who also animated the previous two seasons). The previously announced staff members remain the same.

Rico Sasaki performs the anime's opening theme song "Still Water," while Akuruyo no Hitsuji performs the ending theme song "Hibi o Koete."

The new cast members include:

Sumire Morohoshi as Musia Trick

Hinata Tadokoro as Zaht Brouzdo

The third season will debut on CBC , TBS , and 26 other stations on September 27; on BS NTV on September 29; and on AT-X on October 1. The anime will begin streaming on U-NEXT , d Anime Store , and Anime Hōdai on September 28, and then on other streaming sites on October 1.

Takao Kato ( To Love-Ru , Zoids ) returns to direct the third season at new studio GeyeG Pictures . Daisuke Ōhigashi , who wrote episode scripts for the previous seasons, is now overseeing the series scripts, replacing Yasuhiro Nakanishi . Yūko Yahiro ( Kaguya-sama: Love is War ) is also back to design the characters, and Kujira Yumemi ( In the Land of Leadale ) returns to compose the music.

Returning cast members include:

• Natsumi Fujiwara as Ars Louvent

• Taito Ban as Ritsu Muses

• Narumi Kaho as Charlotte Wraith

• Miho Okasaki as Rosell Kischa

• Kana Hanazawa as Lycia Plaid

• Hitomi Nabatame as Mireille Grandion

• Haruka Tomatsu as Fahm

Kodansha USA Publishing has licensed Natsumi Inoue 's manga adaptation and light novel series (under its Vertical imprint). The company describes the story:

One day when leaving work, Ars Louvent dies and is reborn as a weak aristocrat in another world. Using his “Appraisal” skill, which lets him see the stats of others, he recruits the best people to his side in order to turn his country's fortunes around. Based on a hit light novel with over 30 million online views in Japan!

The first anime season premiered in April 2024 as the debut series for the new "Agaru Anime" programming block on CBC , TBS , and 26 other affiliated networks.

The second season premiered in Japan in September 2024. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

The light novel series debuted in October 2019 on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō (Let's Become Novelists) website. Kodansha publishes the light novel series with illustrations by jimmy . The manga adaptation launched in Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket in June 2020.
author: ANN

title: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Cour 2 Reveals Trailer, Theme Songs, Key Visual, October 11 Premiere
content:
Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 anime revealed a trailer for its Cour 2, which is set to release in October 2026. Studio SILVER LINK returned to animate, with twelve episodes released in the first part. The anime previously revealed a teaser .

The opening theme song is “Forever Song” by Humbreaders, while KID PHENOMENON performs the ending theme song “I’m still breathing. ” You can hear both in the new trailer below.

You can also see the new key visual.

The first season of Mission: Yozakura Family ran for a total of 27 episodes. It was directed by Mirai Minato, who also handled the series composition. Mizuki Takahashi was the character designer, while Osamu Sasaki and Koji Fujimoto were in charge of the music. SILVER LINK was in charge of the animation. The main voice cast includes:

• Reiji Kawashima as Taiyo Asano

• Kaede Hondo as Mutsumi Yozakura

• Katsuyuki Konishi as Kyoichiro Yozakura

• Aoi Yuki as Shion Yozakura

• Yoshitsugu Matsuoka as Kengo Yozakura

• Kazuyuki Okitsu as Shinzo Yozakura

• Yumi Uchiyama as Nanao Yozakura

Mission: Yozakura Family is a Japanese manga written and drawn by Hitsuji Gondaira. It was serialized in Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump from 2019 to 2025, running for a total of 258 chapters . VIZ Media is publishing the manga in English. The story follows Taiyo Asano, a high school introvert who ends up getting married to his childhood friend Mutsumi. Mutsumi who comes from the well known Yozakura (spy) family. As Taiyo learns to fight and protect what he cares about, the mystery behind his own’s family tragedy slowly gets untangled.
author: Anime Corner
